research.note: At Beacon Residential Partners, managing 1,850 doors across 12 communities means turnover lag between paint, repairs, and flooring directly inflates vacancy days. Connecting move-out notices to vendor handoffs keeps turns moving without coordinators having to chase status.

evidence.fact: Operates 1,850 units across Southeast regional portfolio with centralized turnover coordinator
evidence.source: Beacon Residential portfolio directory and careers listing

evidence.fact: Turnover handoffs currently coordinated via coordinator phone calls and email threads

routes.inspection: HappyCo punch-list completion signal & photo link
